cwe_assessments.review_comment: An authenticated user can access any other user's TOTP devices by manipulating the user_id parameter in the URL path. The URL pattern directly accepts any user ID without authorization checks, bypassing normal access controls. The fix requires implementing proper authorization to ensure users can only access their own devices.
